jurisdiction_name: NO COLLEGE HILL WARD 4 (NORTH COLLEGE HILL City)
narrative: No College Hill Ward 4 (City of North College Hill) has 2,542 registered voters, with 56.3% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 8.7% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 35.1%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 26.4 percentage points.
